acceptanceCriteria: A test with a shallow clone whose merge base is beyond the shallow boundary shows changes behind/check-shared refuse or report a named reason instead of a wrong clean result.
A test where the merge base is within the boundary passes with the same result as a full clone.
body: Residual from V1-1710 review fix (PR #1097, head 3d173f824). The dry merge now runs git merge-tree in a temporary bare repository with the real object store as an alternate and GIT_SHALLOW_FILE passed through. The shallow passthrough was checked by hand only, and that check could not distinguish shallow from non-shallow because the depth-2 clone still reached the merge base.
title: sharedpath dry merge: no maintained test for the temporary-GIT_DIR probe in a shallow clone (GIT_SHALLOW_FILE passthrough)
